capabilities: Log sets with weight, reps, and set types from templates or scratch
Detect personal records with a trophy badge and mixed-unit volume math
Run rest, interval, and count-up duration timers
Append a post-workout summary with duration, volume, and PRs to each note
Search a built-in offline catalog of 1,300+ exercises
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no structured, fast way to log gym workouts on mobile, so lifters must record sets, reps, and personal records manually in plain notes.

relations.evidence: The built-in exercise catalog is generated from the MIT-licensed exercises-dataset

summary: Mobile-first gym workout tracker that logs sets, reps, and weights as markdown notes in the vault, with PR detection and built-in timers.
